title: Month view is far too basic on iPhone
body:
Needs much improvement to its monthly view on iPhone.
Even the iPad version is a massive improvement. 

Showing a dot on days with an event is not enough. Even showing when there is multi-day event and/or how many events are on each day would be a great improvement.
